newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African shares end firm on bullion's rise.
newsitem.headline: S.African shares end firm on bullion's rise.

text.p: South African gold shares ended firm on Monday after bullion rose three dollars to around $343 an ounce, dealers said.

Industrials were also firm on positive sentiment in the market due to a better-than-expected gold and foreign exchange reserves number last Friday and talk that funds from the 30 percent stake sale of state telecommunications utility Telkom may come through this month.
However dealers said further gains in the market were hampered by the absence of U.K. players who were enjoying an Early May public holiday.
The gold index ended up 24.1 points at 1,205.7 points, lifting the index from the four year lows it has been plumbing in the last few sessions.
The industrial index gained 24.9 points to 8,563.4 points and the all-share index was 41.4 points stronger at 7,190.4 points.
